blurb: Local git repositories often sit scattered across a filesystem with no easy way to see contribution history at a glance. Built GitGrove, a desktop app with Tauri and React that recursively scans directories using Rust's walkdir crate to discover git repos, then renders per-repo contribution graphs and commit stats through a collapsible sidebar — parsing commit data, grouping it by date, and handling edge cases like GitHub noreply email formats to resolve usernames correctly.
